SELECT 'STG_EDS_LNS_HISTTRANDTL', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) TRAN_DATE FROM D360.STG_EDS_LNS_HISTTRANDTL WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LNS_HISTTRANDTL',COUNT(*),TRAN_DATE FROM EDS.LNS_HISTTRANDTL GROUP BY TRAN_DATE
